profile.title: Frontend Engineer focused on product systems and AI automation
profile.intro: I have over a decade of experience building web products, with a foundation in frontend engineering. My work spans commerce interfaces, admin platforms and tools that help people manage everyday operations. More recently, I have been expanding into LLM-powered applications and workflow automation, taking ideas from small prototypes to tools people can use.

strengths: turning user interviews and operational needs into working tools
structuring complex workflows into reusable interfaces and shared components
planning incremental migrations while preserving existing behavior
taking prototypes through feedback, implementation and deployment

experience_highlights.summary: Built commerce interfaces and modernized admin frontends with shared UI, API integration and form handling.
Built and migrated web tools that support external partners' operational workflows.
Built a modular CMS that lets non-developers create and update commerce content.
Prototyped and deployed tools that generate drafts for people to review, edit and maintain.
Built and operated knowledge search tools combining retrieval, reranking and source-linked responses.
Designed a proof of concept connecting task definitions, AI-assisted code changes and quality checks.

working_style: start with the user's actual workflow
use small prototypes and feedback to refine scope
make edge cases and failure states explicit
include human review in AI-assisted workflows
use shared specifications and tests to support collaborative development
